name: lbb
description: Learning-by-building tools: suggest the next test-first step (lbb:next), revise the current in-flight step (lbb:refine), and validate-then-commit a finished step (lbb:commit), without ever writing the implementation for the learner — plus lbb:next-implement, the opt-in variant that derives the step and writes it for review, and lbb:feature, which plans a whole feature as a phase, builds it step by step with subagents on a branch, and opens a PR for review.
